texts.preamble: M.Paramasivam vs The District Collector on 3 June, 2024 Author: Mohammed Shaffiq Bench: R.Mahadevan, Mohammed Shaffiq W.P.No.12316 of In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated: 03.06.2024 Coram : The Hon'Ble Mr.R.Mahadevan, Acting Chief Justice And The Hon'Ble Mr.Justice Mohammed Shaffiq W.P.No.12316 of 2024 M.Paramasivam .. Petitioner Vs 1.The District Collector, Tiruppur, Tiruppur District. 2.The Deputy Director, The Town and Country Planning, Kumaran Road, Tiruppur District. 3.The Revenue Divisional Officer, Dharapuram, Tiruppur District. 4.The Tahsildar, Kangeyam Taluk, Tiruppur District. __________ Page 1 of 7 M.Paramasivam vs The District Collector on 3 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5080917/ 1 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.No.12316 5.The Divisional Engineer, Tamil Nadu Pollution Control Board, Tiruppur North, Tiruppur District. 6.The President, Sivanmalai Panchayat, Tiruppur District. 7.The Inspector, Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Standards Authority, No.428-431, Office of District Collector, Tiruppur District. 8.The Assistant Executive Engineer, Wro, Aliyar Sub Division, Pongalur, Tiruppur District. 9.The Block Development Officer, Panchayat Union Office, Kangeyam, Tiruppur District.
texts.facts: The petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking issuance of a writ of mandamus forbearing respondent No.10 from illegally running the livestock processing business in Re.Survey No.906/1, Sivanmalai Village, Kangeyam Taluk, Tiruppur District. He would submit that as part of their business, respondent No.10 is packaging, preserving, importing and exporting their __________ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis processed products and due to operation of the meat processing business, several incidents of pollution arose in and around the village. In this regard, the villagers have submitted a representation on 10.03.2024 to the first respondent. Despite receipt of the said representation, the first respondent has not taken any action till date.
